notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: You can now hire sushi chef at level 10!

notes.title: Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator Demo is now live
notes.notes: Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator Demo is now live, ready for all sushi and simulation fans to dive in! This demo brings a massive upgrade over the prologue, featuring a better graphic overhaul that makes the sushi restaurant more vibrant and immersive than ever. A brand-new set of sushi has also been added to unlock, bringing even more variety to the conveyor belt. We have worked hard to enhance every detail, and this demo is the perfect way to experience these exciting improvements. Download the demo now and start running a dream sushi restaurant! Share your thoughts—the feedback is invaluable. Let’s keep the sushi rolling! 🍣
